dedupe_keys.name: yunnan hydropower unit commitment benchmark workbook

description: This workbook supplies inputs and solver results for nine hydropower unit-commitment cases associated with Yunnan, China. Huazhong University of Science and Technology researchers provide head-dependent water rates and feasible discharge bounds, together with quarter-hourly reservoir heads and releases. Case tables contain generating flows, power, unit operating zones and summary measures such as spillage, energy production, low-efficiency operation and computation time. The ninth case includes nine units. A calendar operating period was not established; the results are optimisation benchmarks, not demonstrated historical dispatch. Europe PMC exposes the XLSX file free of charge. The article uses CC BY 4.0, while separate workbook rights remain unknown. Predetermined reservoir releases and operating-zone assumptions limit transfer to other plants. Modellers could compare unit-commitment algorithms or calibrate head-dependent hydro constraints. model-pypsa is a related energy-system modelling tool requiring suitable hydro representation. No workbook or solver implementation was downloaded or run.
